title: Dropping coins to draw a crowd and bringing money home
summary: After a tape change he explains how he attracted a crowd, took the coins home, and his grandmother said he might be a famous dancer like Florence Mills.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: This is the beginning of tape three of Chuck Green.

Yeah. Well now, when I attracted people's attention by dropping these coins, I eventually the people, they would want to give me something, you know, so they would go in their pockets and some of them would take out coins, toss them down by my feet, you see, and they would say, get hot, you know, because they liked tap dancing.

And I had a little -- little tricks in the tap dancing that I knew, and people enjoyed it, so I would make quite a bit of money, which I'd take back to my mother's mother, and I'd tell her what had happened during the day, and she would always tell me where to go the next day -- and the next time, you know, to go somewhere's else, you know. And she said it was a nice thing I was doing; it was healthy and so forth, and that I may grow up to be a famous tap dancer like Florence Mills or someone, you see.
